During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''mission''' was carried out by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sarkli]]'s [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] on the moon [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. After a [[Mission to Rori|failed attack]] on an Imperial [[Rori starship repair facility|starship repair facility]] on Rori, the storm commandos tracked the Rebels to their base. However, the Rebels were able to evacuate the outpost before the arrival of the Empire. While the storm commandos searched the bunker, they were attacked by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Rachi Sitra]]. After a fierce fight, the Jedi was forced to escape. The storm commandos eventually found information about a collaboration between the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] and the Rebels on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="TotC" />
